resources.chapterTitle: Beyond the Basics: Unity Catalog Deep Dive
resources.title: Unity Catalog Governance Decision Reference
resources.description: A compiled reference for the two decisions that recur on almost every real Unity Catalog project: one metastore per region with catalog bindings for isolation, and the real managed-vs-external call with its DEEP CLONE migration path. Pulled from Chapter 1's five lessons into one page.

resources.title: Auto Loader Configuration Cheat Sheet
resources.description: Every `cloudFiles.*` option that actually matters once a feed moves past a demo directory — throughput caps, backfill control, schema evolution modes, and when to flip on file notification mode — plus the RocksDB-backed state mechanism that makes 'already seen' tracking hold up at millions of files.

resources.title: Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines Syntax Reference
resources.description: The current SQL and Python syntax side by side (CREATE STREAMING TABLE / CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW, @dp.table / @dp.materialized_view), a legacy-to-current naming map for teams still reading dlt-era notebooks, and the three Expectations types with when to reach for each.

resources.title: Tag-Based ABAC Masking Policy Starter Kit
resources.description: Real, runnable Unity Catalog SQL templates for tagging PII columns and writing one masking policy that protects every column carrying that tag, in every table, present or future — plus a row-filter template and an audit query for confirming a policy's actual reach. Built around is_account_group_member(), not the legacy workspace-local is_member().

resources.title: DP-750 Practice Scenario Bank
resources.description: Twelve scenario-style practice questions in the exact 'given this situation, which of the following' shape DP-750 uses — twice the coverage of the lesson's own six scenarios, spanning governance, ingestion, pipelines, orchestration, and performance/cost. Each one names the reasoning that rules out the wrong-sounding answer, not just the correct option.

resources.title: Agentic Data Engineering Capability Map
resources.description: A one-page map of all seven Data + AI Summit 2026 capabilities from Chapter 8 — what each one solves, its real published spec (latency, throughput, concurrency), and why none of them work as a standalone product disconnected from Unity Catalog's lineage and governance.
